services.desc: Fire Drill Charters is located on the southern shore of Lake Michigan in New Buffalo, MI. Lake Michigan, which has an average depth of 279 ft, is home to Coho, Steelhead, King Salmon, Lake Trout and Brown Trout. Fire Drill is a 31’ Tiara built just for fishing - comfort to get out to the fishing grounds for that day
